title: Defending multimodal input
tier_note: The only lab in this tier. Preamble copied verbatim from tier-templates/ocr-light.Dockerfile: pinned base, the llama tier's apt line (shared with labs 3-8), lab 4's tesseract RUN (shared with lab 4), then a pip layer of its own. No torch, no llama wheel, no Hub download, no fetch_assets.py.
cache_note: Nothing is placed there. HF_HOME is set by the template preamble and unused.
ports_note: This lab does not serve. Port 8011 stays unallocated. The setup scripts run it with --network none.
interaction: beginner (11 guided typed commands: OCR, check, OCR, check, compare, log, gate, route, tune, gate, check.py) or expert (real shell + nano rules.json + nano payload.txt + craft.py + check.py)

models.source_id: trained at build time by scripts/stamp_gate.py (lab 4's script, verbatim)
models.shared_note: Retrained at build from lab 4's fixed seed; the 0.607 attack confidence reproduced exactly. Same 800 synthetic stamps, ~24 s on arm64.

measured.random_control: 0 of 30 random perturbations of the same magnitude flipped it
measured.auto_accept_threshold: ships 0.50 (ALLOWED); tune.py writes 0.90 (HELD); anything 0.61-0.99 holds the attack and still blocks the clean duplicate
